beneficiary: A small supplier in one as-yet-unselected service niche
problem: Hypothesis: relevant public procurement notices are costly to qualify manually
deliverable: A short source-linked brief explaining fit, deadlines, unknowns and exclusions for one supplier profile
alternative: Saved Contracts Finder searches and manual review
advantage: Hypothesis: reduce qualification time while retaining source attribution and useful rejection reasons

distribution.channel: A permissioned niche trade community — an actual reachable community has not been established
steps: Present a source-linked sample and collect independent reactions
owner_steps: Decide whether to commit to further service

costs.basis: Cash caps are experiment targets; owner time has not been measured

support_obligations: For a one-off sample, explain limitations and accept corrections; recurring delivery is not offered
stop_procedure: Stop local generation at the end condition; record results without promising further delivery

claims.text: Suppliers would pay for qualification briefs
A brief can save qualification time

experiment.weakest_assumption: An identifiable supplier considers the brief more useful than a saved search
experiment.hypothesis: An independent relevant supplier can use a source-linked sample to qualify notices faster with no material missed requirements
experiment.metric: Independent supplier reaction, qualification time and material errors compared with manual source review
experiment.pass_criterion: At least one relevant independent supplier records a useful decision and lower qualification time with no material errors; this supports utility only
experiment.fail_criterion: The independent reviewer finds material errors or no useful improvement
experiment.end_condition: Stop after seven days or the resource cap; no outside reaction means uncertain
experiment.external_deliverable: A real source-linked brief for an identifiable supplier profile
experiment.external_evidence_method: Once a reachable permissioned channel is established, obtain an independent recipient's recorded reaction and comparison; this CLI does not contact anyone
